name: TencentDB Agent Memory
description: Give a team of agents shared long-term memory — turns conversations, docs, and code into governed Chat Memory, Skill, LLM-Wiki, and Code-Graph assets reusable across frameworks.

skills.name: Chat Memory
skills.description: Distills past agent conversations into retrievable memory entries scoped to a user, project, or whole team.

skills.name: Code Graph Memory
skills.description: Builds a structural graph of a codebase that agents query for architecture and dependency context.

skills.name: Wiki Extraction
skills.description: Converts documents and threads into an LLM-readable wiki so knowledge is shared rather than re-derived per agent.

skills.name: Memory Governance
skills.description: Applies access scoping and lifecycle rules to memory assets so teams control what each agent can recall.
